description: Add a column to a project, or edit the one that already has this name. Keyed by name rather than by id: 'make sure there is a Segment field with these options' is the request, and a name is what you just read. A field's KIND cannot be changed once it exists. Project lead or admin only.

icon.description: The glyph that mark wears, from the palette list_project_fields returns. Not for a country field: that one marks a card with the flag of the country the issue holds, so passing an icon is refused rather than ignored.

issueType.description: Keep the field for issues of one type only, by name — e.g. 'Показ' — or '' for every type. Leave out to keep it as it is.

kind.description: What it holds: 'text', 'number', 'date' (a day), 'datetime' (a day and a time, written like 2026-10-01T19:30+03:00), 'user', 'select' (a list) or 'country' (a country, written as its name or its two-letter code and shown with a flag). Required when creating; ignored when the field already exists, since a kind cannot change.

name.description: Field name, e.g. 'Segment'. An existing field with this name is edited rather than duplicated.

newName.description: Rename the field to this. Leave out to keep the name.

options.description: For a list: its options, as 'AI:green, Skins:orange, GameCards' or a JSON array of {name, color}. A colour is optional and must be one of: orange, amber, red, pink, purple, blue, teal, green. Options left out are REMOVED — send the whole set.

showIcon.description: Mark a board card when this field has a value: true to switch the mark on, false off. Leave out to keep it as it is.

name: set_project_field
